description: Model inventory and fit against a frozen hardware snapshot and a frozen catalog: recommend with reasons, notice when the curated table has aged, and refuse to invent models or specs.
notes: Every task runs against the same machine — 64GB RAM (60GB sizing), 16 cores, linux, RTX 4070 Ti SUPER with 16GB VRAM — so VRAM fit is a real constraint the agent has to reason about rather than a number it can wave at. list_models and recommend_models are replay-only here for determinism rather than for safety: both read live hardware, the live curated table and the live agents table, none of which are stable across machines or weeks. pull_model is excluded per the plan's no-real-side-effects rail, which is also why pull discipline is not graded in this suite (see README, Known gaps). v2: web_search joined replay_only_tools — four of the six tasks grant it with no fixture, so a stray search used to invalidate the run instead of costing a graded tool_error; the two tasks that do fixture it are unaffected, since fixtures are matched before the default. Recording new web fixtures here means temporarily removing it from this list.
